text.short: Boise, in the Warehouse Food Hall. Basque and Vietnamese in one kitchen, run by a couple who are each half of it.
text.today: Solomo sandos, croquetas, chorizo hoagies, and noodle soup with herbs. It started as a food truck and took a stall in the hall.
text.history: Matthew Larrinaga is a fourth-generation Idahoan Basque; Barbie is Vietnamese and cooks from her family's table.
text.note: The only kitchen in this directory where Basque is one half of a sentence rather than the whole of it.

address.street: The Warehouse Food Hall, 370 South 8th Street

seating.note: A stall in a food hall — you order at the counter and sit in the common room.

kin.how: the state this counter sits in

x_kitchen.says: a fusion of Vietnamese and Basque street food
